description: A stereo recorder. What arrives at its inputs is written to a wave, raw PCM or MP3 file, passing a level, phase and compressor stage on the way in

params.text: The level of the left channel going to the recording
The level of the right channel going to the recording
Inverts the phase of the left channel
Inverts the phase of the right channel
Ties the two level sliders together so that moving one moves the other
Switches the compressor on the recorded signal on and off

outputs.text: The left monitor output, carrying what is being recorded
The right monitor output, carrying what is being recorded

notes: the first press of the START button opens a dialog for choosing the file to record into, and that dialog opens again before every recording while AUTO ENUMERATE SAVES is switched off
a file picked with CHOOSE destination file... is armed for the next recording only, and the panel menu shows it as ARMED FILE until it is used
menu: SAVE FORMAT — chooses what is written: SAVE 2 channels WAVE files, SAVE 2 channels RAW PCM 32bit IEEE FLOAT files, or SAVE stereo MP3 files
VU Meters setting — VU Meters disabled switches the meters off, RMS timing sets the averaging between 0.1ms and 500ms, and PEAK HOLD timing sets the hold between 50ms and 5000ms
CHOOSE destination file... — picks the file the next recording is written to
AUTO ENUMERATE SAVES — numbers each new save, so a fresh file is written without asking for a name
Bit rate — sets the MP3 bit rate in kbps; 320kbps is written as a variable bit rate and every lower rate as a constant bit rate, default 192kbps
